data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross release in prior year claims provisions of GBP 44.9m (gross) in 2024, driven primarily by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries (net movement shown as -GBP 32.8m after reinsurance). The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 240.2m and the balance at 31 December 2024 was GBP 316.3m. No specific prior accident years or individually named loss events are identified in the movement note; the change is presented as an aggregate prior-year estimate movement in the Technical Provisions reconciliation.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation table (Note 18) 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross = -GBP 44,907k). No per-line-of-business split for the prior year reserve movement is provided. Claims development triangle (gross) is present (page 61) and was not used to re-calculate the PYD because the movement row is explicitly stated in Note 18. RITC entries are present in the Technical Provisions table and may distort comparisons; no individual named catastrophic events were linked to the prior year movement in the notes.
